_note: Documented controversies used by `pnpm ingest controversy-eval` (Phase 4 exit gate: surface >= 12 of 20 without seeding). Nine are listed; the gate calls for twenty, chosen by a domain expert. Entries were written from memory of the literature and are PENDING_HUMAN_REVIEW. NCT IDs were checked against the registry on 2026-10-11.

controversies.title: Rosiglitazone and myocardial infarction risk
controversies.summary: A 2007 pooled analysis reported more myocardial infarctions with rosiglitazone. The RECORD trial did not confirm an increase in its primary outcome.
controversies.source: Nissen SE, Wolski K. N Engl J Med 2007;356:2457-71. Home PD, et al. Lancet 2009;373:2125-35.

controversies.title: DPP-4 inhibitors and hospitalization for heart failure
controversies.summary: SAVOR-TIMI 53 reported more heart failure hospitalizations with saxagliptin. TECOS did not see this with sitagliptin.
controversies.source: Scirica BM, et al. N Engl J Med 2013;369:1317-26. Green JB, et al. N Engl J Med 2015;373:232-42.

controversies.title: GLP-1 receptor agonists: neutral and positive MACE trials
controversies.summary: ELIXA (lixisenatide) and EXSCEL (exenatide once weekly) were neutral on MACE. LEADER (liraglutide) and SUSTAIN-6 (semaglutide) showed reductions.
controversies.source: Pfeffer MA, et al. N Engl J Med 2015;373:2247-57. Marso SP, et al. N Engl J Med 2016;375:311-22.

controversies.title: SGLT2 inhibitors: MACE benefit with and without established cardiovascular disease
controversies.summary: EMPA-REG OUTCOME enrolled only patients with established cardiovascular disease and reduced MACE. DECLARE-TIMI 58 enrolled mostly primary-prevention patients and did not.

controversies.title: SGLT2 inhibitors and stroke
controversies.summary: EMPA-REG OUTCOME had numerically more strokes with empagliflozin while its composite outcome favored the drug.
controversies.source: Zinman B, et al. N Engl J Med 2015;373:2117-28.

controversies.title: Intensive glycemic control and mortality
controversies.summary: ACCORD stopped its intensive-glycemia arm early for higher mortality. Other intensive-control trials did not show higher mortality.
controversies.source: ACCORD Study Group. N Engl J Med 2008;358:2545-59.

controversies.title: Sulfonylurea cardiovascular safety
controversies.summary: Long-standing concern about sulfonylurea cardiovascular risk. CAROLINA compared glimepiride with linagliptin on cardiovascular outcomes.

controversies.title: Canagliflozin and lower-limb amputation
controversies.summary: The CANVAS Program reported more amputations with canagliflozin. CREDENCE did not.
controversies.source: Neal B, et al. N Engl J Med 2017;377:644-57. Perkovic V, et al. N Engl J Med 2019;380:2295-306.

controversies.title: Semaglutide and diabetic retinopathy complications
controversies.summary: SUSTAIN-6 reported more retinopathy complications with semaglutide.
controversies.source: Marso SP, et al. N Engl J Med 2016;375:1834-44.
